overview: A stratified, enclosed city-state operating on automated logistics, corporate transit conduits, and strict epistemic clearance tiers. Factions operate with independent agendas regardless of protagonist intervention.

immutable_facts.statement: The Metro Core is structured into four concentric subterranean rings separated by reinforced atmospheric bulkheads.
immutable_facts.notes: Physical structure cannot be altered without municipal clearance.

immutable_facts.statement: Atmospheric filtration grids require uninterrupted geothermal power conduits routed from Sub-Level 8.
The Great Grid Severance occurred 42 cycles ago, cutting off the Outer Periphery from municipal life support.

mutable_world_state.active_epoch: Cycle 143 — Post-Severance Reconstruction & High Grid Strain

factions_control.Central Transit Directorate: Full administrative control of Upper Rings and rail corridors
factions_control.Outer Rim Reclamation Syndicate: De-facto governance over lower scrap quadrants
factions_control.Consortium Logistics Union: Monopoly over freight manifests and staging bays

resource_distribution.geothermal_power: Constrained in Outer Ring; 100% capacity in Apex Spire
resource_distribution.clean_water: Rationed municipal supplies; black market filtration active

mutable_world_state.global_tensions_index: Elevated — pending contract negotiations between Transit Directorate and Reclamation Syndicate

factions_and_tensions.name: Central Transit Directorate
factions_and_tensions.agenda: Maintain automated rail grid authority and enforce tier clearance borders.
objectives: Secure automated staging bays against unauthorized access
Deploy surveillance probes across transit junctions

tensions.source_of_friction: Jurisdictional boundary dispute over Sub-Level 4 cargo terminals

factions_and_tensions.name: Outer Rim Reclamation Syndicate
factions_and_tensions.agenda: Siphon power conduits and secure unregulated freight transit for fringe colonies.
objectives: Tap geothermal bypass lines in Sub-Level 6
Establish independent barter markets along Periphery corridors

tensions.source_of_friction: Frequent impounding of salvage rigs and courier vessels

unresolved_mysteries.title: The Sub-Level 8 Deep Core Protocol
unresolved_mysteries.secret_truth: The geothermal tap is slowly draining an ancient pre-collapse reactor that will breach threshold in 3 years.
unresolved_mysteries.discovery_conditions: Retrieve black-box diagnostics directly from the Sub-Level 8 primary manifold.
